title: Contextual-identifier workload replication
description: Exact replication of iteration 017 after the one cross-task, independently justified compiler change: position is now a contextual identifier. The task population, partitions, instruction core, agent, and strict parity gate remain unchanged.

matrix.derivation: For each replicate and language: 8 one-task + 4 two-task + 2 four-task + 1 eight-task sessions.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-task success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check task success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict workload parity.

secondary_analysis: Report the full scale curve at bundle sizes 1, 2, 4, and 8.
Report both session totals and per-assigned-task values; never present amortized values without their denominator.
Report bundle success, hidden-task success, first-check bundle success, first-check task success, repairs, protocol compliance, prompt size, input/output tokens, and elapsed time.
Preserve every failed or timed-out session and every task-level hidden judgment.
Compare iteration 018 against iteration 017, but do not attribute stochastic baseline movement to the compiler change.
change_rule: Do not change syntax or compiler semantics from one workload, task, or transcript. A future proposal requires a recurring issue across at least two unrelated tasks plus an independent case for general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability.
instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character Parley skill is injected once per session and remains byte-for-byte unchanged. No further instruction-compression experiment is permitted.
feature_boundary: The only compiler difference from iteration 017 is contextual use of the existing word position. Unsupported modulo is intentionally unchanged.
